tags.chapter_name: Center of Mass Momentum and Collision

question.text: Two bodies of the same mass are moving with the same speed, but in different directions in a plane. They have a completely inelastic collision and move together thereafter with a final speed which is half of their initial velocities of the two bodies (in degree) is -

solution.text:
Momentum conservation along x direction

2mvcosθ=(2m)v2

cosθ=12

θ=60°

then angle between their initial velocities

= 120°
